title: Scholarships for African students in Europe
summary: This file already starts and ends on her voice (first sound at 0.00 s, "Bye." ends 0.2 s before the end) and has no pause over 1.2 s, so the cuts are her retakes: two "scratch that" moments, one false start, one stumble, and a double take on the description-box line. **Check the very first word:** the recording starts on "…be a Nigerian or an African student"; the kit line is "If you're a Nigerian…", so the first word or two may have been clipped when the file was trimmed.

cuts.why: She says "scratch that" and repeats the line. Keeps the second take: "So you apply directly to the programme you want on the programme's website."
She starts a story about her own application, says "don't, scratch that, I won't talk about that", then restarts. Keeps "What I would advise is that you pick two or three programmes…"
Same line twice ("So you apply through the course, and by DAAD,"); keeps the complete one: "you apply through the course, by the course's deadline."

"I keep saying that before. Scratch that. Scratch that. I keep saying that." Keeps "Again, link will be in the description box." and goes straight to the Netherlands. (To also drop the link reminder, start this cut at 280.25.)
"a weekly, a monthly stipend rather": keeps "It covers your tuition, a monthly stipend rather, …" (the trailing "rather" stays; it can't be cut cleanly).

decisions:
- **First word**: is "If you're" missing at 0:00? If the original file has it, re-export from there; if not, the opening line is "Be a Nigerian or an African student…" and may need a text card or re-record of two words.
- **3:04 "I don't even pronounce that"** (after "DAAD EPOS scholarship", 184.50 to 185.95): a funny aside; keep or cut.
- **6:56 "Nigerians do get in as well. Nigerians get in really well."**: she says it twice; optional cut 416.33 to 417.20 keeps only "…and Nigerians get in really well" (not counted).
- **8:07 "So do(n't) the same motivation letter"**: whisper hears "So doing the same motivation letter"; she means *don't use the same letter for every application*. Listen: if she actually says "do", the line contradicts her own advice and should be cut (487.20 to 488.95) or covered with a caption.
kit:
**Skipped from the kit:**
- "The DAAD, the German Academic Exchange Service" (she just says DAAD) and "DAAD uses the OECD's list of developing countries, and Nigeria is on it".
- "the DAAD publishes a brochure with the master's courses it funds, all connected to development".
- EPOS: "Some of [the 2027 deadlines] were in October 2026. Check the current list for the ones still open."
- The exact SI window "8th to the 24th of February" (she says "I think that short window is 8 to 24, 2027", without the month; the on-screen card should carry it).
- NL Scholarship: the EEA definition (EU + Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein) and the University of Groningen example (deadline 1 February 2027, motivation letter, transcripts, admission letter).
- AISS admission dates (2 December 2026 to 2 February 2027) and "I wasn't big on scholarships when I was trying to get in … even got a partial one, so imagine if you're very intentional".
- Chevening: "Applications for 2027 to 2028 closed in October 2026" (she says "I think the application has closed as of October").
- Motivation letter: "write it yourself, because you know yourself better than anyone".
- Closing: "if you applied and got in, come and give your testimony under this video".

**Added in the recording:** "this one is literally open to literally anyone" (Erasmus Mundus); "It's also one thing I found"; "I don't even pronounce that"; "Nigerians get in really well"; transcripts tip ("an official student transcript also helps"); motivation letter "stay within the boundaries of what they asked … sell your passion … be original"; references early; apply only on official websites.

**Facts to check:**
- 2:20 **AISS**: she says "I think the admission for that is also open currently". Her kit says admissions run 2 December 2026 to 2 February 2027, so in October 2026 it is **not open yet**. Needs a caption or a cut.
- 3:35 EPOS course list "for 2027-28" (whisper wrote 2020-28; she likely says 2027/28 as in the kit).
- 3:54 "if you're looking to start in 2028, you already have to start preparing now": fine, matches the kit's intent.
- 4:33 SI scholarship window 8 to 24 February 2027 and the University Admissions deadline (15 January 2027 in the kit; she says "I think the deadline is for January"): confirm on si.se / universityadmissions.se before posting.
- 5:02 NL Scholarship "5,000 euros for your first year", "used to be called the Holland Scholarship": matches the kit.
- 6:01 Stipendium Hungaricum "last round closed 15th January 2026, next round not open yet": as of October 2026 per the kit.
- 4:50 Orange Knowledge Programme "ended in 2024": same as the kit; double-check (Nuffic).
- 1:55 Erasmus Mundus living allowance €1,400 a month for up to 24 months: matches the kit (EU Erasmus+ page).
